_about: Local model bench: one score per job, per model (python -m bench). Every model name, threshold, fixture path and limit lives here (AGENTS.md Rule 0). Results go to out_dir/<date>.json and <date>.md under the checkout it runs in; a rerun on the same date skips the (model, job) cells already done, so a run stopped by the lease or the battery picks up where it left off.
_models: Default for --models. Installed models only: the bench never pulls one. A model worth trying goes in suggest with its exact pull line for Chuen to approve.

lease._about: The shared GPU lease (orchestra/local_team/lease.py). In-process jobs run under the bench's own hold; jobs marked lease "own" take it themselves per call (eval/run_eval.py, the local team), so the bench releases it first. Still busy after wait_s: the run stops and is resumable.

battery._about: No local batch job on battery (9 Nov 2026). Checked before every cell with orchestra/power.py; unknown counts as AC, as for dispatch. ORCHESTRA_POWER overrides the reading.

score._about: A case's score is the share of its checks that passed (0-1); a job's score is the mean over its cases. ok = every check passed.
score._ground_min_share: Factual check: at least this share of an answer's words (min_word_chars or longer) must appear in the case's source text.

pick._about: bench pick: per job, the model with the highest score; models within quality_margin of the best are tied and the faster (lower median seconds per case) wins. A job needs min_cases scored cases, with no errors, for a model to count.

_today: Per job: where its model comes from when model_routing.json leaves it null. entry = a config.json models entry; orchestra = a key of orchestra/models.json or config.json.

denisse_brain._about: eval/run_eval.py --only these cases (clean and live) in a subprocess with the model set; its pass/fail is the score. Ids must be in eval/cases.py. group, if set, is used instead of only.

orchestra_local_team._about: orchestra/local_team/baseline.py on these fixtures; the scout's yes/no per fixture is the score, plans and admission are reported alongside.

atrium_autopilot._about: atrium/autopilot.py model_classify on synthetic candidates, labelled by hand.
